subject: general
question: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme is aimed at boosting manufacturing. Which of the following sectors is NOT covered under the PLI scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tourism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme is a flagship initiative by the Government of India to boost domestic manufacturing, attract investments, and enhance exports.
 
• The PLI scheme currently covers 14 key sectors, including pharmaceuticals, electronics, automobiles, and textiles, among others.
 
• Tourism is not one of the sectors included under the PLI scheme, as the initiative primarily focuses on sectors that can strengthen India's manufacturing capabilities and global competitiveness.
 
• The scheme aims to reduce import dependency and create additional employment opportunities in India.
 
• Under the PLI scheme, eligible companies are provided financial incentives based on incremental sales of goods manufactured in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pharmaceuticals:**

 
 
• The PLI scheme for pharmaceuticals aims to enhance India's domestic manufacturing capacity of bulk drugs, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and drug intermediates.
 
• It seeks to reduce dependency on imports, particularly from China, and promote self-reliance in the pharmaceutical sector.
 
• The scheme has been allocated a financial outlay of Rs. 15,000 crore.
 
 
 
• **Automobiles:**
 
 
• The PLI scheme for the automobile and auto component sector focuses on promoting the production of advanced automotive technologies and components in India.
 
• It encourages the manufacturing of electric vehicles (EVs), hydrogen fuel cells, and other green mobility solutions.
 
• This scheme is expected to attract significant investments and generate employment in the automotive sector.
 
 
 
• **Electronics:**
 
 
• The PLI scheme for electronics has been instrumental in establishing India as a global hub for manufacturing mobile phones and electronic components.
 
• It provides incentives to companies manufacturing smartphones, semiconductors, and other electronic devices in India.
 
• The initiative has attracted investments from global giants like Apple, Samsung, and Foxconn.
